page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9i.large is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs utilizing an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor running at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz. The instance is equipped with 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU.

This server configuration does not include any bundled local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and application data. Network connectivity is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps. There are no integrated graphics processing units or complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this instance type.

With its dedicated CPU allocation and 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.c9i.large offers a compute-focused resource density. This profile is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring consistent CPU performance without the overhead of larger memory footprints. Suitable workloads include lightweight web serving, microservices, build systems, and compute-bound utility tasks that do not demand local storage or high memory capacity.
